feat.Meta Principle: While in Syvestro's control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard one die of your choice in each roll. Additionally, when an enemy model is destroyed while in Syvestro's control range, a friendly Faction model in Syvestro's control range can remove d3 damage points. Meta Principle lasts for one turn.

rules.Attached: Before the start of the game, attach this model to a friendly Faction Leader for the rest of the game. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it. The attached model is part of its Leader's battlegroup.

rules.Command Attachment [Crucible Guard Rocke: This command attachment can be added to a Crucible Guard Rocketmen unit.

rules.Command Attachment [Crucible Guard Infan: This command attachment can be added to a Crucible Guard Infantry unit.

feat.Overdose: Di Morray gains one elixir token and 1 focus point. Warjacks in his battlegroup currently in his control range also gain 1 focus point. Additionally, di Morray gains Range Amplifier this activation. (When a model with Range Amplifier casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +5 RNG.)

feat.Arcanodynamic Catalysis: Enemy upkeep spells and animi in Locke's control range immediately expire. For one round, when an enemy model is forced, casts a spell, or spends 1 or more essence, focus, or fury points while in Locke's control range, you can place one catalytic token on a model in Locke's battlegroup currently in her control range. If a model casts a spell by spending essence, focus, or fury, Arcanodynamic Catalysis triggers only once. A model cannot have more than three catalytic tokens on it at any time. A model gains +1 DEF and +1 ARM for each catalytic token on it. The weapons of a model with one or more catalytic tokens gain Damage Type: Magical. Remove one catalytic token from each affected model at the end of their activation.

feat.Overwhelming Force: Friendly Faction models currently in Mackay's control range gain Run & Gun and their weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Additionally, when a friendly Faction construct model makes a damage roll against an enemy model in Mackay's control range, the damage roll is boosted. Overwhelming Force lasts for one turn. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

feat.Air Support: Put a Rocketman unit and a Rocketman Ace solo into play. Place each model completely within 3" of Bennet.

feat.Fox Hunt: Choose an enemy model/unit in Gearhart's control range. Friendly Faction models gain Prey against the chosen model/unit. A model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit in Gearhart's control range to be the prey. Fox Hunt lasts for one turn.

rules.Companion [Marshal General Baldwin Gearh: This model is included in any army that includes Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart. If Gearhart is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Gearhart's battlegroup.

Admonition.text: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup, the affected model can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.

Ignite.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to melee attack damage rolls. Affected models gain Critical Fire on their melee attacks.

Purification.text: Continuous effects, animi, and upkeep spells in the spellcaster's control range immediately expire.

Revive.text: Target one friendly trooper model. Return one destroyed Grunt model to the target model's unit. The Grunt is returned with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target model. The Grunt model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

Stygian Abyss.text: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers -4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

Guided Fire.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain boosted ranged attack rolls for one turn.

Instability Equation.text: Target friendly warjack stands up and is no longer stationary. If the warjack was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains up to 3 focus points and gains Unstable for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which a model with Unstable spent more than 1 focus point, roll a d6. If the roll is equal to or less than the number of focus points spent, the model with Unstable explodes and other models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll. Remove the model with Unstable from play.)

Burning Ash.text: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

Disintegration.text: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.

Force Hammer.text: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell's point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.

Iron Flesh.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.

Telekinesis.text: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.

Bombshell.text: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.

Engine of Destruction.text: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.

Jackhammer.text: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.

Redline.text: Target warjack in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.

Road to War.text: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster's control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.

Sentry.text: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)

Fail-Safe.text: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

Jumpstart.text: Shakeable effects on models in the spellcaster's battlegroup that are currently in its control range expire. Models that suffered shakeable effects this turn are not affected by Jumpstart.

Mobility.text: Models in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

Return Fire.text: When target friendly Faction model is targeted by an enemy ranged attack, after the attack is resolved the affected model can make one basic melee or ranged attack, then Return Fire expires. Return Fire lasts for one round.

Arcane Propulsion.text: Target cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.

Firepower.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.

Occultation.text: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.

Tides of War.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn.

Windstorm.text: The spellcaster gains Warping Winds. Windstorm lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

Boundless Charge.text: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.

Deceleration.text: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.

Hot-Shot.text: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

Snipe.text: Target friendly Faction model's/unit's ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

abilities.Alchemical Mask: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.
abilities.Chemical Warfare: When an enemy model takes damage from a continuous effect while in this model's control area, double the damage.
abilities.Field Alchemy: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its activations.
abilities.Ephemeral Vitae: This model can cast one spell this activation without spending focus points.
abilities.Impenetrable Haze: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This AOE remains in play for one round. This model gains Stealth while completely within the template.
abilities.Super Fuel: Friendly Faction construct models currently within 5" of this model gain +2 SPD this turn.
abilities.Bond [Lukas]: If Apollo begins the game in Lukas' battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Apollo is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Apollo is bonded to Lukas and is in his control range at the start of Lukas' activation, Lukas can remove d3 damage points.
abilities.Arcane Realignment: While within this model's Leader's control Range, that Leader can reroll one failed arcane attack roll each turn.
abilities.Arcane Repeater: While this model's Leader is within 5" of it, that Leader's control range is extended 2".
abilities.Bulldoze: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.
abilities.Reposition [3\"]: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.
abilities.Attack Type: Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules.
abilities.Acid Wash: This attack causes corrosion damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
abilities.Blood of Urcaen: This attack causes magic damage. On a critical hit, upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit hit immediately expire.
abilities.Incendiary: This attack causes fire damage, and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
abilities.Ice Cage: On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative -2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Ram: When an enemy model is hit by this weapon during this model's Combat Action, it becomes knocked down and can be pushed 1" directly away from this model. If the model hit is pushed, this model can immediately advance 1" directly toward it.
abilities.Attached: Before the start of the game, attach this model to a friendly Faction Leader for the rest of the game. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it. The attached model is part of its Leader's battlegroup.
abilities.Magic Ability: Performing a Magic Ability special action counts as casting a spell.
abilities.Empower (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.
abilities.Guidance (★ Action): RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.
abilities.Harmonious Exaltation (★Action): RNG 5. Target this model's Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.
abilities.Transmogrification Elixir: This model can use Transmogrification Elixir once per game during your Control Phase. Immediately mark all of this model's damage boxes and replace it with Big Alyce.
abilities.Traumatic Transformation: This model begins the game as Little Alyce. When all of this model's damage boxes are marked, instead of becoming disabled this model is replaced with Big Alyce. Damage points in excess of this model's remaining unmarked damage boxes are not applied to Big Alyce's damage boxes. If this model is replaced with Big Alyce during its activation, its activation ends. After this model is replaced with Big Alyce, apply effects that were on it to Big Alyce. When this model is replaced by Big Alyce, Big Alyce is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area.
abilities.Hyper-Aggressive: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.
abilities.Hyper-Regeneration: Remove d3 damage points from this model at the start of each of its activations.
abilities.Jump: After it makes a full advance during its Normal Movement and before it performs its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.
abilities.All-Terrain (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.
abilities.Repair [d3 +1] (★ Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.
abilities.Arcing Fire: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.
abilities.Withering Humor: On a direct hit, living and undead models hit by this attack suffer -2 ARM and lose Tough for one turn unless they can ignore gas effects.
abilities.Journeyman Warcaster: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.
abilities.Soul Vessel: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.
abilities.Dodge: This model can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.
abilities.Dogfighter: This model gains boosted attack and damage rolls against models with Flight.
abilities.Flying High: Ranged attacks targeting this model suffer -3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. This model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.
abilities.Reposition [5\"]: At the end of this model/unit's activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.
abilities.Swift Hunter: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".
abilities.Decrepitation: This weapon gains an additional die on damage rolls against construct and undead models.
abilities.Hallucination: On a direct hit, living models hit suffer Double Vision for one round. A model suffering Double Vision suffers -1 to attack rolls. Additionally, a model targeted by a model with Double Vision gains Dodge for that attack. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)
abilities.Putrefaction: On a direct hit, models hit gain Acid Blast for one round. (When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 corrosion blast damage roll and the corrosion continuous effect.)
abilities.Unnatural Affliction: On a direct hit, models hit lose Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire for one round.
abilities.Armor-Piercing (★ Attack): When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.
abilities.Both Barrels (★Attack): This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.
abilities.Iron Bane: Models hit without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. (A construct suffering Rust suffers -2 ARM. Rust lasts for one round.)
abilities.Brutal Damage: On a direct hit, gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against the target directly hit.
abilities.Sky-Dropped: Attacks with this weapon ignore cover. Models with Flight do not suffer blast damage from this attack.
abilities.Side Step: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.
abilities.Blind: A model is hit by this attack suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)
abilities.Burster: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, the closest three enemy models within 3" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After this damage is resolved, remove the boxed model from play.
abilities.Shadow Bind: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)
abilities.Puncture: On a direct hit, all models hit suffer d3 damage points.
abilities.Acid Treatment (★Action): RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Corrosion for one round.
abilities.Heat Treatment (★Action): RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Fire for one round.
abilities.Magical Treatment (★Action): RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Damage Type Magical for one round.
abilities.Prowl: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.
abilities.Smoke Bombs (★Action): Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.
abilities.Spontaneous Combustion: On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon's damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.
abilities.Pyrocatalyst: This attack causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
abilities.Vitriolic Trajectile: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
abilities.Cumbersome: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.
abilities.Granted: Dodge: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)
abilities.Granted: Reposition [2\"]: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [2"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [2"]'s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.)
abilities.Mission Objective: Once per game at any time during its unit's activation, this model can use Mission Objective. When it does, choose an enemy model/unit in this model's LOS. This activation, models in this unit gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against the chosen model/unit.
abilities.Aggressive: This model can run or charge without spending a focus point.
abilities.Anchor: Friendly warrior models cannot be knocked down while B2B with this model.
abilities.Set Defense: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.
abilities.Shield Guard: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.
abilities.Ashen Veil: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.
abilities.Aetheric Blast: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down. Cloud effects touched by the spray expire.
abilities.Alchemical Accelerant: On a direct hit, a model hit by this attack suffers Oil for one round. (When a model affected by Oil suffers a fire damage roll, the roll is automatically boosted.)
abilities.Alchemical Vents: At the beginning of this model's activation, choose one of the following Alchemical Vents effects. While within 5" of this model, models are affected by the chosen effect. While its S system is crippled, this model loses the benefits of Alchemical Vents. Alchemical Vent effects last for one round.
abilities.Psychoactive Gas: A living warbeast directly hit by this attack gains 1 fury point unless they can ignore gas effects.
abilities.Psychomorphic Destabilizer: This attack causes magical damage. Models hit by this attack lose Incorporeal for one round.
abilities.Steam Pressure: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, this weapon gains +4 RNG that activation.
abilities.Chem Trail: On a direct hit, models hit by this weapon suffer the effects of the chosen Alchemical Vents effect. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Chem Trail.
abilities.Reload [1]: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.
abilities.Black Humor: This weapon gains Continuous Effect: Corrosion and Grievous Wounds for this attack. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)
abilities.Experimental Warhead: Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire and Corrosion continuous effects.
abilities.Girded: This model and friendly models B2B with it gain Resistance: Blast.
abilities.Force Aura (★Action): While within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and ARM against ranged attacks. Force Aura lasts for one round.
abilities.Psychic Assault (★Attack): Psychic Assault is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. This attack ignores LOS.
abilities.Psychokinetic Force (★Action): While within 5" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 MAT and RAT. Psychokinetic Force lasts for one round.
abilities.Steady: This model cannot become knocked down.
abilities.Critical Knockdown: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.
abilities.Coagulum of Entropy: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Resistance: Corrosion. When an affected model is hit by a melee attack, the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous effect. Coagulum of Entropy lasts for one round.
abilities.Fortemorphic Elixir: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and gains Overtake. Fortemorphic Elixir lasts for one round. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)
abilities.The Good Stuff: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough and cannot be knocked down but suffers –1 to attack rolls. The Good Stuff lasts for one round.
abilities.Heal [d3 +2] (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +2 damage points from it.
abilities.Revivifier: This model can use Revivifier once per game at any time during its activation. While within 5" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain Tough. Additionally, when a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while within 5" of this model, that model can remove 1 damage point. Revivifier lasts for one round.
abilities.Anesthesia: A living model damaged by an attack with this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Take Down: Models disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by this model are removed from play.
abilities.Brain Damage: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.
abilities.Quake: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.
abilities.Rust: This attack causes no damage. Instead, on a direct hit constructs hit suffer –2 ARM for one turn.
abilities.Mental Force: This model can use Mental Force at the beginning of each attack. If it does, all attack and damage rolls resulting from the attack are boosted. After the attack is resolved, this model suffers d3 damage points.
abilities.Poltergeist: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.
abilities.Smite (★ Attack): The model hit is slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.
abilities.Carapace: This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.
abilities.Brutal Charge: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.
abilities.Flame Burst: When this model boxes an enemy model with this weapon, enemy models within 1" of the boxed model suffer the Fire continuous effect.
abilities.'Jack Hunter: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warjacks.
abilities.Combat Alchemy: Once during this model's combat action, this model can spend an elixir token to cast a spell.
abilities.Combat Chemistry: At the start of each of this model's activations, it gains one elixir token. This model can have up to three elixir tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend elixir tokens to gain additional melee attacks, boost an attack roll, or boost a damage roll. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.
abilities.Unstable Concoction: Unstable Concoction is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 12/8 arcane attack. Add 1 to the AOE value of this attack if the target is suffering from the Fire or Corrosion continuous effect. Add 2 to the AOE if the target is suffering from both.
abilities.Granted: Dual Shot: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)
abilities.Take Up: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.
abilities.Detox (★Action): Remove any number of elixir tokens from this model.
abilities.Health Care: This model does not suffer damage from elixir tokens while it has two or fewer elixir tokens and is within 5" of Little Alyce.
abilities.Juicer: During your Maintenance Phase, you can place one elixir token on di Morray. For each elixir token on di Morray, he gains +1 ARC and AAT. At the end of each of his activations, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the number of elixir tokens on di Morray, he suffers 1 damage point for each elixir token on him. Di Morray cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.
abilities.Rapid Healing: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.
abilities.Exothermic Reaction: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, enemy models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and suffer the Fire continuous effect. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Then the boxed model is removed from play.
abilities.Field Marshal [True Strike]: When a warjack in this model's battlegroup damages a warjack or warbeast with a melee attack, choose which column or branch suffers the damage.
abilities.Repair [d3+3] (★Action): RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 + 3 damage points from it.
abilities.Resourceful: This model can upkeep spells on models in its battlegroup without spending focus or fury points.
abilities.Flare: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack lose Stealth and suffer –2 DEF for one turn.
abilities.Fail-Safe: Target friendly Faction warjack gains +2 ARM and does not suffer the effects of crippled systems.

abilities.Mobility: Models in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

abilities.Arcane Propulsion: Target cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD, +2 DEF, and Flight.
abilities.Firepower: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls.
abilities.Occultation: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains Stealth.
abilities.Tides of War: While in the spellcaster's control range, models in its battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. Tides of War lasts for one turn.
abilities.Windstorm: The spellcaster gains Warping Winds. Windstorm lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers -3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)
abilities.Arms Caddy: Once per turn at any time during its activation and while within 5" of Mr. Clogg, Gearhart can use Arms Caddy. Replace his ranged weapon with one of the weapons on Mr. Clogg's card. Gearhart keeps that weapon until he uses Arms Caddy again.
abilities.Battle Plan: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation.
abilities.Bloody Well Done!: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains an additional die on each model's first non-spray ranged attack roll this turn.
abilities.Give 'Em What For!: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Reciprocate for one round. (When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved a model with Reciprocate can make one basic ranged attack against the attacking model.)
abilities.Precision Strike: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.
abilities.Mechanikal Seizure: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
abilities.Companion [Marshal General Baldwin Gearh: This model is included in any army that includes Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart. If Gearhart is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Gearhart's battlegroup.
abilities.Hit the Deck!: Ignore this model when determining which models would be hit by an AOE. If it would be hit by an AOE, it instead becomes knocked down. While this model is knocked down, ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss.
abilities.Johnny on the Spot (★Action): RNG 5. Target Gearhart. If Gearhart is in range, he immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack.
abilities.Momentum: A small- or medium-based model directly hit by this attack is slammed d3" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon. In addition to suffering a normal damage roll, large-based models hit by this attack become knocked down.
abilities.Bombshell: On a critical hit, models hit are thrown d6" directly away from the attacker. Roll distance once for all models affected. Move models farthest from the attacker first. Instead of suffering blast damage, models hit but not directly hit suffer a POW 10 damage roll. The POW of collateral damage is 10.
abilities.Engine of Destruction: The spellcaster gains +2 SPD and +4 MAT and +4 to its melee damage rolls for one turn.
abilities.Jackhammer: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup currently in its control range immediately makes one basic melee attack.
abilities.Redline: Target warjack in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains +2 SPD and can run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks without spending focus. Additionally, the affected model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and collateral damage rolls. At the end of each of its activations, the affected warjack suffers d3 damage points.
abilities.Road to War: When a friendly Faction model in the spellcaster's control range destroys one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in the spellcaster's battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance as a result of Road to War only once per turn.
abilities.Sentry: Target friendly Faction model gains Rapid Fire. (A model with Rapid Fire can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.)
abilities.Boundless Charge: During its activation, target friendly Faction model can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges. Boundless Charge lasts for one turn.
abilities.Deceleration: While in the spellcaster's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attack damage rolls. Deceleration lasts for one round.
abilities.Hot-Shot: Target model in the spellcaster's battlegroup gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.
abilities.Snipe: Target friendly Faction model's/unit's ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.
abilities.Burning Ash: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster's control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.
abilities.Disintegration: The model hit suffers –2 ARM for one round. A model boxed by Disintegration is removed from play.
abilities.Force Hammer: Instead of suffering a normal damage roll, a non-incorporeal model Force Hammer hits is slammed d6" directly away from the spell's point of origin and suffers a POW 12 damage roll. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 12.
abilities.Iron Flesh: Target friendly Faction model/unit gains +2 ARM and Resistance: Blast.
abilities.Telekinesis: Place target friendly model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed by Telekinesis only once per turn.
abilities.Iron Bane (Alchemical Vents): Affected enemy construct models without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. A construct suffering Rust suffers –2 ARM.
abilities.Miasma of Death: Affected living enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them unless they can ignore gas effects.
abilities.Berserk: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.
abilities.Impervious Flesh: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.

properties.Decrepitation: This weapon gains an additional die on damage rolls against construct and undead models.
properties.Hallucination: On a direct hit, living models hit suffer Double Vision for one round. A model suffering Double Vision suffers -1 to attack rolls. Additionally, a model targeted by a model with Double Vision gains Dodge for that attack.
properties.Putrefaction: On a direct hit, models hit gain Acid Blast for one round. (When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 corrosion blast damage roll and the corrosion continuous effect.)
properties.Unnatural Affliction: On a direct hit, models hit lose Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire for one round.
properties.Attack Type: Each time this weapon is used to make an attack, choose one of the following special rules.
properties.Acid Wash: This attack causes corrosion damage. Models hit by this attack suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
properties.Blood of Urcaen: This attack causes magic damage. On a critical hit, upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit hit immediately expire.
properties.Incendiary: This attack causes fire damage, and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
properties.Ice Cage: On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative -2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.
properties.Ram: When an enemy model is hit by this weapon during this model's Combat Action, it becomes knocked down and can be pushed 1" directly away from this model. If the model hit is pushed, this model can immediately advance 1" directly toward it.
properties.Arcing Fire: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.
properties.Withering Humor: On a direct hit, living and undead models hit by this attack suffer -2 ARM and lose Tough for one turn unless they can ignore gas effects.
properties.Armor-Piercing (★ Attack): When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.
properties.Both Barrels (★Attack): This model gains +4 to the damage roll for this attack. This model cannot make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during an activation in which it makes a Both Barrels attack.
properties.Iron Bane: Models hit without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. (A construct suffering Rust suffers -2 ARM. Rust lasts for one round.)
properties.Brutal Damage: On a direct hit, gain an additional die on this weapon's damage rolls against the target directly hit.
properties.Sky-Dropped: Attacks with this weapon ignore cover. Models with Flight do not suffer blast damage from this attack.
properties.Critical Freeze: A critical attack inflicts stationary on models hit.
properties.Blind: A model is hit by this attack suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)
properties.Burster: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, the closest three enemy models within 3" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After this damage is resolved, remove the boxed model from play.
properties.Shadow Bind: A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)
properties.Puncture: On a direct hit, all models hit suffer d3 damage points.
properties.Spontaneous Combustion: On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon's damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.
properties.Pyrocatalyst: This attack causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.
properties.Vitriolic Trajectile: This attack causes corrosion damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.
properties.Cumbersome: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.
properties.Aetheric Blast: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down. Cloud effects touched by the spray expire.
properties.Alchemical Accelerant: On a direct hit, a model hit by this attack suffers Oil for one round. (When a model affected by Oil suffers a fire damage roll, the roll is automatically boosted.)
properties.Psychoactive Gas: A living warbeast directly hit by this attack gains 1 fury point unless they can ignore gas effects.
properties.Psychomorphic Destabilizer: This attack causes magical damage. Models hit by this attack lose Incorporeal for one round.
properties.Steam Pressure: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, this weapon gains +4 RNG that activation.
properties.Chem Trail: On a direct hit, models hit by this weapon suffer the effects of the chosen Alchemical Vents effect. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Chem Trail.
properties.Reload [1]: This model can spend 1 focus or fury point to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.
properties.Black Humor: This weapon gains Continuous Effect: Corrosion and Grievous Wounds for this attack. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)
properties.Experimental Warhead: Models hit by this attack suffer the Fire and Corrosion continuous effects.
properties.Critical Knockdown: On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.
properties.Anesthesia: A living model damaged by an attack with this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
properties.Brain Damage: A model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.
properties.Quake: On a direct hit, models hit become knocked down.
properties.Rust: This attack causes no damage. Instead, on a direct hit constructs hit suffer –2 ARM for one turn.
properties.Smite (★ Attack): The model hit is slammed d6" directly away from this model. If the model hit has a larger base than the attacking model it is moved only half the distance rolled. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.
properties.Brutal Charge: This model gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls with this weapon.
properties.Flame Burst: When this model boxes an enemy model with this weapon, enemy models within 1" of the boxed model suffer the Fire continuous effect.
properties.Exothermic Reaction: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, enemy models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and suffer the Fire continuous effect. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Then the boxed model is removed from play.
properties.Flare: On a direct hit, models hit by this attack lose Stealth and suffer –2 DEF for one turn.
properties.Mechanikal Seizure: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.
properties.Momentum: A small- or medium-based model directly hit by this attack is slammed d3" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon. In addition to suffering a normal damage roll, large-based models hit by this attack become knocked down.
